title: Crispy Savoy Cabbage Bites with Labneh Sauce
description: A Japanese-inspired appetizer featuring crispy fried cabbage and a creamy labneh sauce. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together flour and middle eastern seasoning blend (if using)
In another shallow dish, place panko breadcrumbs
Dip each cabbage slice into the flour mixture, coating both sides, then into the breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere
Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
Add a few cabbage bites to the skillet (do not overcrowd) and fry until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side
Drain the fried cabbage bites on paper towels
Meanwhile, mix labneh with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt in a small bowl
Serve the crispy cabbage bites with the chilled labneh sauce for dipping
